blocking_repairs.requirement: Every observation feature must be shown not to deterministically encode target.
baseline_hint must be removed or replaced with a feature that is not deterministic or invertible from target.
Add observation-only decode challengers including hint_inverter and deterministic cyclic-shift families.
Harness must block if observation-only predictors recover target above the predeclared threshold.
001B must remain negative evidence and must not be reinterpreted as positive replacement-Gate4 support.

recommended_co_repairs.requirement: Budget parity classifications must be computed from actual field differences and able to fail organically.

Provenance code_path_hash must bind to real producer functions and computed scores.
Leakage scan must cover unsanitized persisted artifacts or bundles and detect value leakage.
Active-query and baseline-independence checks must be computed, not decorative booleans.
Add positive controls and organic failure tests for each repair gate.
